title: docs(skills): name the publish-time findings, drop the fallbackLocale refusal workaround, name the MCP door tool set
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRTHmmdYhGsPrpf8EzYYxUk)_

Fixes #35245
Part of #35569
Part of #35460

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：给 AI 写应用用的技能说明更新了五处：状态流转规则、审批分支、外部调用超时这几个老陷阱，现在直接告诉作者「发布时会被拦下，这样改」；勾选框「必填」的真实含义写清楚了；多语言说明去掉了一个已经不需要的绕法；智能体可用工具的清单补全了；按钮只写了显示位置却没绑对象时会被拦下，也写进了界面技能。
- 为什么做：这些检查和修复都已经合并上线，技能说明还在讲旧的说法，照着写的作者会多做无用功，甚至把正确的写法改错。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字和评测题，不影响运行；写错了再改一版即可，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：这是对外发布的技能文字，合并前需要你审核批准。

## What changes

Text only, in five published skills. No token ceiling moves; every addition is paid for inside its own file.

**objectstack-data** (card of this PR)

- `SKILL.md`, state machine paragraph: a `state_machine` rule that runs on insert declares `initialStates`, or publish refuses it (`state-machine-no-initial-states`). An update-only machine (`events: ['update']`) needs none.
- `SKILL.md`, yes/no flag bullet: "never `required`" is gone. On a boolean `required` refuses only `null`; an unchecked box is a value, so it never means "must be checked". A box that must be checked is a `validations[]` `script` rule, shown inline.
- `rules/validation.md`, State Machine Validation: the same refusal and the same update-only exception, in one sentence.
- `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`: eval 10 (required checkbox) follows the new meaning and no longer fails an answer that keeps `required: true`; eval 11 names the refusal and the update-only exception.

**objectstack-automation** (card of this PR)

- `SKILL.md`, node type list: a `type` no executor runs is refused when the flow is published to a running server (`flow-node-type-no-executor`).
- `SKILL.md`, `http` row: with no positive `timeoutMs` the call has no timeout and raises the warning `flow-http-timeout-missing`.
- `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`: `initialStates` is no longer "optional, omit to keep the legacy behaviour"; it names the refusal and the update-only exception. The approve / reject bullet says the out-edges are labelled exactly `approve` and `reject`, and that publish refuses the flow otherwise (`flow-approval-decision-unrouted`).

**objectstack-i18n** (the refusal-label card)

- `SKILL.md`: the warning that refusal messages fall back to `fallbackLocale` / `defaultLocale` is replaced by the behaviour on main: validation, delete-restriction and permission-denial messages name fields and objects in the request's language, and a request in `sourceLocale` reads the inline label. The `fallbackLocale` table row is untouched.
- `evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, eval 11: the "also declare `fallbackLocale: 'en'`" reasoning and its `must_contain` entry are gone.

**objectstack-ai** (the tool-source card)

- `SKILL.md`, resolution ladder, source 4: `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES`, every tool the MCP door registers (the `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` file pair included), resolved only for a skill MCP can offer (`mcpPrompt` not `false`); on a `mcpPrompt: false` skill a name only the door serves still warns, with its own hint. No eval or reference under `skills/objectstack-ai/` quotes the list.

**objectstack-ui** (card of this PR)

- `rules/actions.md`, placement paragraph: a standalone action that declares `locations` and no `objectName` is refused at validate and at publish (`action-no-object-binding`); the fix is `objectName`, or `locations: []` for a headless action. Added on claim amendment 7024130793.

**Changeset**: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Why

The rule is the check first and the prose second (ruling E1 = A on the epic card). The five publish-time rules, the narrowing of the state-machine rule to machines that run on insert, the refusal-label change and the door tool constant are all on main; the skills still taught the older reading.

## Tests

<details><summary>Readings at head a42688df（第四轮修 L2 的 S1；第三轮读于 f97d0d16，合入 main 986a0f20 并还 4 token；第二轮读于 a7b62986；第一轮读于 d5fca85e）</summary>

第四轮（L2 记录 7024839798 的 S1）：`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`「Opening in a New Tab」一节的示例 `PrintA3Action` 原先声明了 `locations` 却没有 `objectName`，正是同文件说会被 `action-no-object-binding` 拒绝的写法；现补 `objectName: 'lead'`。同文件删词抵付、含义不变：`never a predicate and never a gate` → `never a predicate or a gate`；`"Action completed"` 后多余的 `toast`；`in `list_item` contexts.` → `in `list_item`.`。token 3708 → 3708 / 3711，上限未动。提交 a42688df 叠在 f97d0d16 上，未合 main、未 rebase、未 force。在 a42688df 上 token 棘轮、`check:skill-docs`、`check:skill-refs`、`check:skill-served-sections`、`check:skill-links`、`check:skill-identifier-liveness`、`check:nul-bytes`、overlap-check 均 exit 0；`check:skill-examples` 本地前置未满足（exit 3），由 CI 判定。CI 在 a42688df：28 success、16 skipped、0 失败。os-dev-report 7024934065。

第三轮：合入 origin/main 986a0f20（合并提交 73cf6a94，无冲突，未 rebase、未 force）。合并后 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 读数 3712，超过上限 3711，因为 main 对同一文件的修改先落地。本 PR 在自己那段里删词还了 4 个 token（`that object's record surfaces` 删 `record`，`returns or assigns the new values` 删 `the new`）：3712 → 3708 / 3711，行数 258 → 258。在 f97d0d16 上，token 棘轮、`check:skill-docs`、`check:skill-refs`、`check:skill-served-sections`、`check:skill-links`、`check:nul-bytes` 和 overlap-check 均 exit 0；下方其余读数不变。CI 在 f97d0d16：全部 success 或 skipped。

Round two: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 258 → 258 lines, 3333 → 3333 of 3333 tokens, paid with three parentheticals of the locations table and the wording of the same paragraph. The token ratchet, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes` and the overlap check were re-run at a7b62986, all exit 0; `dispatch-gates --commands` derives the same 51 commands.


Files to read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the yes/no flag bullet: it reverses earlier advice ("never `required`").
2. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, eval 10: two `must_not_contain` entries are removed.
3. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, node tables: seven rows lose a few words to pay for two new clauses.

Line readings, whole file before → after: ai `SKILL.md` 462 → 464; automation `SKILL.md` 478 → 478; `state-machines-and-approvals.md` 388 → 390; data `SKILL.md` 476 → 476; `rules/validation.md` 331 → 329; data eval 387 → 386; i18n `SKILL.md` 523 → 522; i18n eval 155 → 155. All `SKILL.md` files together: 4853 → 4854.

Token readings (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0), tokens / ceiling: ai `SKILL.md` 6693 → 6737 / 6801; automation `SKILL.md` 7045 → 7045 / 7045; `state-machines-and-approvals.md` 5933 → 5934 / 5936; data `SKILL.md` 6709 → 6710 / 6710; `rules/validation.md` 2761 → 2758 / 2761; i18n `SKILL.md` 6332 → 6323 / 6333. Ratcheted total 195676 → 195710; whole bundle 274972 → 275033.

Removed to pay: three states and the default `severity` of the state-machine JSON example in `rules/validation.md`; three asides in `state-machines-and-approvals.md`; a few words in seven node-table rows of automation `SKILL.md`; two example state names and some wording in data `SKILL.md`.

Local gates: 51 commands derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`; 49 ran and exited 0, among them `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:doc-formula-expressions` (after building its closure), `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`. NOT MEASURED locally: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (each exits 3, prerequisite: a whole-workspace build this diff does not touch; CI builds it). `check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean.

No served `*.generated.ts` changes: the one served skill file is generated from the ask skill, which this PR does not touch, and `check:skill-refs` reports its nine generated files in sync.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `flow-node-type-no-executor` is judged only by a running server's publish, not by the CLI, so the hint that there is no `query_record` node stays.
- The row of the `requires` table that says an absent approvals capability leaves "no executor for the node type" is left as it is: a flow loaded from files at boot does not pass the publish gate.
- The door tool list on main holds 21 names; the skill names the constant and states no count.
- One marked example block (`os:check`) is edited: `PrintA3Action` in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` ("Opening in a New Tab") gains `objectName: 'lead'` (L2 S1, commit a42688df). No other `os:check` block changes.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 and prints the six rows above; `git grep -n "fallbackLocale: 'en'" -- skills/objectstack-i18n` shows only the config example in `SKILL.md`.

Landing: `skills/**` is a governed surface; this PR stays a draft until its review record exists.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request; three cards folded by the seat's fold rule.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
